zh: 追前面那匹！待会儿给我留个道？
直说吧，弯道能让我先走吗？
帮个忙，下一段给我点空当！
en: Chasing the leader! Can you leave me a lane?
Straight up: can I go first into the bend?
Do me a favor. Save me some room ahead!
Nice! I owe you one.
Thanks! I'll return the favor.
Thanks! Here I come!
Got it. I'll make my own move.
Fair enough. See you up there!
No worries. I'll find another opening.
All right! Match my pace!
Here you go! Make it count!
Give me a moment. I'm chasing too.
Not this time. I need my own sprint.

zh: 过弯时能留出外侧吗？更有效率。
我们各跑一边，能省一次减速。可以吗？
下一段我需要直线，你能留些余量吗？
en: Could you leave the outside open? It's more efficient.
Separate lines save us both a brake. Deal?
I'll need a straight run ahead. Can you leave room?

zh: 多谢，这样就不用抢道了。
en: Understood. I'll leave you a lane next time.
Thanks. No need to fight for the line now.
I owe you one. Logged.
Understood. I'll adjust my line.
Got it. I'll look for another opening.
Fair. I'll stick with my plan.
Yes. Use the straight to accelerate.
Copy that. Short window.
A boost isn't worth it right now.
Hold your line. Wrong moment.

zh: 我好不容易追上啦，能让我先过一下吗？
前面好挤呀，能借我一点空当吗？
我们别撞在一起啦，你能让我靠过去吗？
en: I finally caught up! Mind if I go ahead?
It's crowded up there. Can you leave me room?
Let's not bump! Can you let me move over?

zh: 谢谢！下回换我给你加油！
en: Great! I'll help you too!
Thank you! I'll cheer for you next time!
Aw, thanks for helping!
No worries. I can wait!
Of course. You go first!
Okay! Watch that bend!
Of course! Let's go together!
Coming! Here's a little boost!

zh: 现在来不及呀，下回好吗？
en: Can't make it now. Next time?
Sorry! I'm trying to catch up too!

zh: 呵呵，借我一点外道？我保证少捣乱。
猜猜我想从哪儿过？给我留条道就好。
商量一下，前面的空当借我用一次？
en: Heh. Spare me the outside? I'll behave. Mostly.
Guess which side I'll pass on? Just leave me a lane.
How about lending me that opening up ahead?

zh: 咦，答得真干脆。我记住了。
有意思。下回我也放你过去。
en: Ooh, that was quick. I'll remember it.
Interesting. I'll let you through next time.
Thanks. Don't worry, I mean it this time.

zh: 呵呵，我还以为你会答应呢。
那就看看谁先找到空当。
en: Heh. Thought you'd say yes.
Fine. I've got another line.
Let's see who finds an opening first.
Heh. Hold those reins.
I'll help. Don't get smug about it.

zh: 呵呵，这笔账现在不划算。
这么快就想要我帮忙啦？
en: Heh. Not a good deal right now.
Asking for help already, are we?

zh: 若方便，可否把外侧让给我片刻？
请给我留一点位置，我想从侧面过去。
有劳。下一段能让我先行吗？
en: If it's convenient, may I use the outside for a moment?
Some room to pass, if you please.
Would you be so kind as to let me through ahead?

zh: 多谢。你的体贴，我记下了。
承你照顾。改日一定奉还。
en: Thank you. I'll remember your courtesy.
Much obliged. I'll return the favor.
A most gracious assist. Thank you.

zh: 既然如此，我们各凭本事。
en: Of course. You have your own line.
No trouble. I'll wait for another chance.
Very well. May the better rider win.
My pleasure. Stay with me.
Certainly. Allow me to give you a push.

zh: 抱歉，请容我先顾好自己的路线。
en: Pardon me. I must mind my own line first.
I'm afraid the timing isn't right.

zh: 拜托嘛，下个弯给我让一小点？
我追得好累，能让我从旁边溜过去吗？
就借一下外道啦，求你啦～
en: Pretty please, a little room at the next turn?
Catching up was hard! Can I slip past on the side?
Can I borrow the outside lane? Pleeease?

zh: 谢谢！下次换本姑娘帮你！
en: Yay! You're the best!
Thanks! Next time I'll help you!
Deal! Sending you a kiss!
Hmph. I can manage on my own!
Fiiine. I'll find another gap!
It's okay. Good luck out there!
All right! Boost coming!
Hang on! I'm here to help.

zh: 唔，等我先追上前面那匹嘛～
en: Let me catch the rider ahead first!
Next time, okay?
